  comms-minio:
    profiles: ["comms-media"]
    image: minio/minio
    container_name: comms-minio
    command: server /data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${FLEET_COMMS_MINIO_ROOT_USER:-}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${FLEET_COMMS_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}
    volumes:
      - comms_minio_data:/data
    mem_limit: 512m
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/minio/health/live"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - comms-media
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
